steps: Both new starter options show exact ordinary GDScript source in Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px. Mode, path, focus, source and reachable Create/Cancel controls persist; cancelling writes nothing.
Create opens an ordinary unsaved TXT draft; Save adds exactly its source and registration while preserving all existing author files.

Manage existing behavior explicitly registers one script reference. The ordinary behavior editor adds one character binding and two text parameters, retains every consumer binding, and preserves focus/review in three languages. Apply changes only a draft; Save changes only the behavior JSON.

A real Godot run publishes initial landing, one accepted jump and one later landing from the browser-authored binding. Native upward motion is observed; the existing animation subscriber issues playback and the event-audio subscriber issues two executed play receipts. Events and recipients remain visible at 390px in all three languages.

Publisher, animation subscriber and audio subscriber actions open the frozen behavior document with distinct binding property identities; exact selection is checked when the runtime supplies a source range. Observation and navigation preserve the completed job and every author file after explicit Save.
